name: Tazoudasaurus
sum: Tazoudasaurus is a basal sauropod from the late Early Jurassic (Toarcian) of Morocco, one of the most complete basal sauropods known.
wsnote: Range quoted by the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; the holotype individual has a few disarticulated skull bones and a nearly complete lower jaw.
material: Several specimens representing ten individuals from two localities near Toundoute.
biology: A small sauropod with primitive features such as a prosauropod-like mandible with spatulate, denticle-bearing teeth.
author: Allain et al. 2004
